description:
Herbert and Lansdowne are delighted to present this stunning home at 119 Carysfort Park to the market this week — a fantastic opportunity to secure a truly exceptional property in one of Blackrock’s most sought-after and desirable neighbourhoods. Nestled within the beautiful Carysfort estate, complete with its own park and playground, this home is perfectly positioned just moments from excellent schools, the bustling energy of Blackrock Village, the DART, and scenic coastal walks. Tucked away in a quiet cul de sac, this is a rare find.
Step inside and be immediately impressed by the bright, spacious, and beautifully proportioned layout. The bathrooms have all been completely renovated, fully tiled, fully fitted and finished to an exceptionally high standard. The contemporary kitchen/diner forms the true heart of the home, while the generous living room stretches across the back of the house, flowing seamlessly out to the wonderful south facing rear garden — flooded with light for the majority of the day.
The thoughtfully landscaped south facing garden is a suntrap, perfect for busy families or anyone who loves to unwind and entertain outdoors.
There’s ample communal parking right in the cul de sac. The attic is partially floored and fitted with a staire attic stairs.

Accommodation briefly comprises: 
Entrance hall; guest WC; modern kitchen/diner; living room opening out to the garden; 2 double bedrooms(primary ensuite), 1 single bedroom, family bathroom. 

Location: 
This highly sought after estate is just off Carysfort Avenue connecting Stillorgan and Blackrock Villages. There is a wealth of amenities within easy reach including shops, bars and restaurants along with supermarkets, gyms and cafes. 

Some of Dublin's best regarded schools are all within walking distance including Carysfort National School, Guardian Angels National School, St Andrews Junior and Senior School, Willow Park National School, Blackrock College and Newpark Secondary school.

Transport links include Dart and Dublin Bus. 

KITCHEN/DINER: 
Light fitting, high quality fitted kitchen, splashback area, stainless steel sink, area fully plumbed, integrated fridge freezer, integrated dishwasher, oven, hob, extractor fan, wooden floor.
